description: A read-only verifier checks whether a task is actually complete before the turn closes.

description: Policy decisions before model calls and before tool execution, with optional automatic low-risk approval.

description: Read-only checks for credentials metadata, plugin sources, filesystem permissions, sessions and network exposure.

description: Discover, inspect, install, update and remove curated DSH extensions from one place.

description: Human-agent task queues, remote replies, attachments, approvals and real-time workspace delivery.

name: Enterprise Data Fabric
description: Unified virtual filesystem over cloud drives, messaging, object stores, databases and business tools.

name: Artifact Studio
description: Editable prototypes, dashboards, presentations, images and video governed by a design system.
